description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom TextView for displaying log data received via the LogNode interface, including methods for formatting and displaying log messages with different priorities and handling log chaining.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that outputs log data received through the LogNode interface, capable of formatting log messages and chaining log nodes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and outputs a log message with priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable, updating the UI thread and passing to the next LogNode if set.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line in the LogView display.
